notes.title: Why censoring?
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

it hasn’t been long since our release.
We carefully read all your reviews and activities on our communityhub.
A lot of people have an issue with the censoring. That is why we want to address this topic.

There are several reasons why we, as developers, decided to release a censored project. 

First of all, the whole adult game topic is still very new on Steam. The bottom-line is that Steam will allow every legal content. 

But what is legal content? Basically content approved by the respective governments, that means, each country's government has to decide what is legal or not, in a time and resource demanding process. Which already led to problems for other projects. 

As all this is very current, we as developers want to make sure not to get hit with our first project and lose our main source of income. 

This is why we decided to stay calm with these new policies on Steam and releasing a censored version of our game which we have also translated to our pricing.

We can understand that this might be upsetting after Steam announced that uncensored content is now “possible”.

We hope you guys can understand our decision.

Best,
CVN Team
